$comment: Pitwall's CI contract (scripts/affected.mjs, .gitea/actions/app-gates, ADR 0014 §6; the field list is in .gitea/actions/README.md): a leg of ci.yml on Linux (the app's own checks, then fmt, clippy, tests, doc tests, deny, then the frontend: audit, lint, build, index.html check, unit tests with the 80 % guard; the Chromium e2e in two parallel legs, `e2e`/`e2eShards`, and the WebKit e2e in a leg of its own, `e2eWebkit`, on main, tags, the nightly and a dispatch with `webkit`) and, for the code that differs there (the server with its Windows service and macOS launch agent code), the Rust gates on Windows and macOS. The Tauri shell (pitwall-app) is tested apart and last on Linux only: tauri-build copies its placeholder sidecar over target/debug/pitwall-server, which stays out of the way of the server's end-to-end tests (they start the pitwall-fake-engine test bin as a child process). Installers and the release are .gitea/workflows/pitwall-release.yml (a pitwall-v* tag, a push to main, the nightly or a manual run), through the shared app-release.yml.
rustChecks: TZ=Pacific/Auckland cargo nextest run -p pitwall-core -p pitwall-server --profile ci
e2e: PW_E2E_PREBUILT=1 PW_E2E_PORT=$((4390 + E2E_INDEX)) npx playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 --fully-parallel --shard=$E2E_SHARD
